description: This file implements the Cell HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) management, including handling of HARQ processes for both downlink and uplink, with support for NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) mode. It defines classes and functions for HARQ process allocation, acknowledgment handling, timeout management, and per-UE HARQ entity management within a scheduler context.

classes.name: noop_harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of harq_timeout_notifier that does nothing on timeout events.

classes.name: base_ntn_harq_history
classes.description: Template class managing HARQ history for NTN mode, handling ACKs and saving HARQ info.

classes.name: ntn_dl_harq_alloc_history
classes.description: Handles DL HARQ processes in NTN mode, providing find functionality.

classes.name: ntn_ul_harq_alloc_history
classes.description: Handles UL HARQ processes in NTN mode, providing find and sum pending TBS functionality.

classes.name: cell_harq_repository
classes.description: Manages HARQ processes for a cell, including allocation, deallocation, timeout handling, and retries for both DL and UL.

classes.name: cell_harq_manager
classes.description: High-level manager coordinating DL and UL HARQ processes, UE addition/removal, and slot indication.

classes.name: dl_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Handle class for DL HARQ processes, providing acknowledgment and retransmission control.

classes.name: ul_harq_process_handle
classes.description: Handle class for UL HARQ processes, providing acknowledgment, CRC info, and retransmission control.

classes.name: unique_ue_harq_entity
classes.description: Represents HARQ entities per UE, allowing reconfiguration, HARQ process management, and status queries.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the current slot, handling timeout processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HARQ processing, deallocating all HARQ processes.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE is present in the HARQ manager.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE with specified number of DL and UL HARQ processes.

methods.name: destroy_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and deallocates its HARQ processes.

methods.name: new_dl_tx
methods.description: Allocates a new DL HARQ process for a UE.

methods.name: new_ul_tx
methods.description: Allocates a new UL HARQ process for a UE.

methods.name: cancel_retxs
methods.description: Cancels retransmissions for a HARQ process.

methods.name: handle_harq_ack_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events for HARQ processes, including logging and deallocation.

methods.name: alloc_harq
methods.description: Allocates a HARQ process for a UE with specific parameters.

methods.name: dealloc_harq
methods.description: Deallocates a HARQ process, removing it from timeout and pending lists.

methods.name: handle_ack
methods.description: Processes ACK/NACK for a HARQ process, possibly deallocating or setting pending retransmission.

methods.name: set_pending_retx
methods.description: Marks a HARQ process for retransmission.

methods.name: handle_new_retx
methods.description: Handles retransmission request for a HARQ process.

methods.name: reserve_ue_harqs
methods.description: Reserves HARQ processes for a new UE.

methods.name: extend_ue_harqs
methods.description: Extends the number of HARQ processes for a UE.

methods.name: destroy_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE and its HARQ processes.

methods.name: cancel_retxs
methods.description: Cancels retransmissions for a specific HARQ process.

methods.name: find_ue_harq_in_state
methods.description: Finds a HARQ process for a UE in a specific state.

methods.name: is_ntn_harq_mode_b_enabled
methods.description: Checks if NTN mode B HARQ is enabled.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates HARQ state based on current slot, handling timeouts.
